svg.aria-label: The folder layout the layout analyzer enforces. app and cmd are the composition root: configuration, wiring and the real clock; only they may import everything. service holds the operations over core and ports, next to the adapters, one folder per driver such as store and server. core holds pure rules with no I/O. port is the contract: interfaces, sentinel errors and the coded error type. schema and api hold the contract data. Each layer imports only the layers below it.
